It stays alive as long as you complete at least one of the two activities (affirmation or meditation) each day. It only breaks if a full day goes by without completing either.
You didn\'t complete any habit yesterday. Activate the healer to keep your overall streak — this doesn\'t replace what you do today.
Healer activated: your overall streak stays intact.
You have 1 healer saved for the next day you miss.
Two days in a row completing your habits. Not bad.

A healer protects your overall streak if you ever forget to complete your habits: you activate it the next day, and that day counts as if you\'d done it. You can hold up to 1 healer at a time, and it doesn\'t replace what you do today — it just gives you room for one slip-up.
